title: Snow Rush 3D
desc: Snow Rush 3D is a winter sled run for one or two players. Slip down snow-covered tracks, dodge snowmen, read tricky turns and grab gifts before the course ends. Share the keyboard on desktop for an immediate side-by-side distance race.
howto: Steer along the safest snowy line.
Jump over ramps, obstacles and awkward turns.
Collect gifts while holding your speed.
Race to the longest distance in two-player mode.
tips: In two-player mode, agree on screen sides before starting.
Do not fight for gifts if it puts you into an obstacle.
Release steering early; snowy tracks drift after a turn.
